# 1453 Day-1 streamlined core bootstrap (idempotent; runs on_game_start with after-lobby safety net).
on_game_start = {
    on_actions = { oe_wp3_1453_on_start }
}

on_game_started_after_lobby = {
    on_actions = { oe_wp3_1453_after_lobby }
}

# Verified vanilla EU5 1.4.9 country-formation dispatcher (_hardcoded.txt:5403, root = newly formed country).
on_new_country_formed = {
    on_actions = { oe_wp3_byz_restored_bootstrap }
}

oe_wp3_1453_on_start = {
    effect = {
        oe_byz_1453_bootstrap_core_ios = yes
    }
}

oe_wp3_1453_after_lobby = {
    effect = {
        oe_byz_1453_bootstrap_core_ios = yes

            limit = {
                NOT = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
                current_year = 1453
                country_exists = c:BYZ
                exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars

            c:BYZ = { oe_byz_1453_found_morea_theme = yes }
        }
    }
}

# Zero-pulse-cost event-driven bootstrap for 1648/1776 Restored BYZ (fires once on formation).
oe_wp3_byz_restored_bootstrap = {
    trigger = {
        tag = BYZ
        is_rebel_country = no

        NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
        NOT = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }

    effect = {
        oe_ml_mark_start = yes

    }
}
